title: First-Day Rental Fee Amount — Bluegate Moving Truck Rental
content:
**Rate clause.** The first-day rental fee of a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental contract is the class base rate — the class rental fee for one rental period, as shown on the class rate card — for one rental day, rounded to the cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical contracts)

| Vehicle class on the contract | Class base rate (USD) | First-day rental fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Pickup Truck | 19.95 | 19.95 |
| Bluegate 15 ft Moving Truck | 39.95 | 39.95 |

The class read is the vehicle class on the contract, which is the class reserved even when a larger vehicle is handed over.
